summary: order-service began returning HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders at 12:12:31Z, ~2.5 min after deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0, 12:10Z) added a new MarginCheckValidator and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). Every error is a NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 for orderType=FNO, with "marginProfile is null". Error rate went from ~0.2% to ~18% and stayed there through 13:59Z; the release is still "live" (not rolled back). All resource metrics (cpu ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool ~14, latency ~150ms, restarts 0) and all downstream services (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway both ~0.2% error) are flat, ruling out resource exhaustion, capacity, and dependency failure. Root cause: bad deployment (dep-5101) — the new F&O margin check does not handle a null marginProfile, throwing an uncaught NPE that fails FNO order placement.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bad deployment dep-5101: new MarginCheckValidator throws uncaught NPE on null marginProfile for FNO orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, deployed 12:10Z) replaced the legacy margin validation with a new MarginCheckValidator that dereferences a null marginProfile for FNO (derivatives) orders, throwing an uncaught NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88. The validator sits in the order-placement path, so POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500. Origin: order-service code release.

recommended_actions.rationale: The uncaught NPE turns a missing/absent margin profile into a 500 instead of a controlled rejection.

findings.statement: No ERROR-level log exists in order-service between 08:00Z and 12:12:30Z (total_matched 0).
The NPE errors continue through 13:58Z (all still FNO / marginProfile null), i.e. the incident is ongoing.
order-service resource metrics are flat across the incident: cpu_pct ~40 (mean 40.14), memory_pct ~60 (mean 60.08), db_pool_in_use ~14 (mean 14.04), restarts 0 cumulative throughout.
order-service latency_p99_ms stayed ~150ms across the whole window (mean 149.97), with no step change at 12:12Z.
Downstream services show no error increase: exchange-gateway error_rate flat ~0.21% and pricing-engine flat ~0.22% across the same window.
The only config/feature-flag change in the window is cfg-2101 on notification-service (email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21Z), unrelated to order-service.

The fault originates in the new MarginCheckValidator code path added by dep-5101; the removed legacy validateMargin() presumably handled (or never reached) the null marginProfile case, so the refactor introduced the uncaught NPE for FNO orders.
